name: flow-2026
notes: Early game from the 2026 fixture (accel-2026-start, 28 Aug 2026, just past the start of the user's accelerated Resistance campaign; the harness cannot start a brand-new campaign) for a year, with the strategist directing every non-player faction (user, 2026-10-22: 'try a fresh 2026 run'). One consolidated run: flow-2034's observations plus the strategist's. Run tools/strategist.ps1 -Harness alongside. Passive player (the Autopilot gives no orders).
asserts: all(e['t'] == e['checkpoint'] for e in events('strategist', ev='applied'))
all(len(e['applied']) >= 7 for e in events('strategist', ev='applied'))
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], e.get('applied'), e.get('ignored')) for e in events('strategist')]
[(e['t'], k, v.get('intent')) for e in events('strategist', ev='applied') for k, v in e['directives'].items()]

[(e['t'], {k: {f: v.get(f) for f in ('posture', 'strikeTargets', 'spare', 'raidFactions', 'warChestMonths', 'rivals', 'friends', 'defend') if v.get(f) is not None} for k, v in e['directives'].items()}) for e in events('strategist', ev='applied')]
[(e['t'], e['faction'], e['system'], e['target']) for e in events('strategist-defend')]
[(e['t'], e['faction'], e['source']) for e in events('strategist-intel')]
[(e['t'], e.get('faction'), e.get('what'), e.get('client'), e.get('patron')) for e in events('human-client')]
[(e['t'], e['f'], e.get('self'), {k: (v.get('hate'), v.get('war')) for k, v in e.get('toward', {}).items()}) for e in events('human-hate', f='ResistCouncil')][-1:]

{f: (faction(first, f).get('habs') if faction(first, f).get('habs') is not None else faction(first, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(first, f).get('stations', 0), faction(last, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(last, f).get('stations', 0), faction(first, f).get('cps'), faction(last, f).get('cps')) for f in ['AlienCouncil', 'ResistCouncil', 'DestroyCouncil', 'CooperateCouncil', 'ExploitCouncil', 'EscapeCouncil', 'SubmitCouncil', 'AppeaseCouncil']}
events('doctrine')[0]['doctrine'] if count('doctrine') else None
(count('doctrine', ev='shifted'), count('shame'))
(faction(first, 'AlienCouncil').get('scv'), faction(last, 'AlienCouncil').get('scv'), faction(last, 'AlienCouncil').get('ships'))
(faction(first, 'AlienCouncil').get('bases'), faction(last, 'AlienCouncil').get('bases'))
[(e['t'][:7], e['bases'], e['cap'], round(e['drip'], 1), round(e['upkeep'], 1), e['stock']['Exotics'], e.get('warChest'), e.get('largeFactor')) for e in events('economy')][::3]
(count('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet'), count('goal+', type='CaptureHab'), count('raid'))
median([r['scv'] / r['defThreat'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet') if r.get('defThreat')] or [0])
(count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True), count('combat', attacker='AlienCouncil', occurred=True, winner='AlienCouncil'))
{f: count('hab-', faction=f) for f in ['ResistCouncil'] + ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
events('fleet')[-1]['bySize'] if count('fleet') else None
(count('ship-built'), {s: count('ship-built', size=s) for s in ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large', 'Huge']})
sum(e['earthBlocked'] for e in events('economy'))
(count('trade', to='AlienCouncil'), sum(e['resources'].get('Metals', 0) for e in events('trade', to='AlienCouncil')))
[(f['faction'], round(f['contempt'], 2)) for f in events('disposition')[-1]['factions']] if count('disposition') else None
{f: count('human-ship-built', f=f) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
sum(count('human-ship-built', f=f) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil'])

{f: (faction(first, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('scv'), faction(last, f).get('ships')) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
{r: count('human-market', ok=True, resource=r) for r in ['Metals', 'NobleMetals', 'Water']}
(count('human-market', ok=True, buyer='ExploitCouncil'), count('human-market', ok=False, buyer='ExploitCouncil'))
(count('human-drain-guard'), count('human-yard-unblock'), count('human-mc-invest'), count('direct-invest'), count('losing-big-fix'))

{f: (faction(first, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(first, f).get('stations', 0), faction(last, f).get('bases', 0) + faction(last, f).get('stations', 0)) for f in ['ResistCouncil'] + ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
{f: faction(last, f).get('self') for f in ['ResistCouncil'] + ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']}
